title: Three places, rounded or truncated
task: Report a calculator result to three places after the decimal point, rounded or truncated, with its setup beside it.

steps.text: When a result shows as a fraction, the decimal shortcut shows it as a decimal, which is Cmd+Shift+A on a Mac.
The round function with 3 as its second input gives the three-place rounded form of a result.

exam_habit.text: A decimal approximation reported to fewer than three places after the decimal point loses the answer point, and three places rounded or truncated both earn it.
An intermediate value rounded before it is used again moves the reported answer, so only the final result is rounded.
A value obtained from a graphing calculator without the equation, function or definite integral that was entered loses the setup point, so the setup is written beside the result.

sources.anchor_quote: A reported answer should be accurate to three places after the decimal point, rounded or truncated.
at most one point is not earned for inappropriate rounding
